test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

__Learning a poem by heart__ is meaningless if you do not understand it.

options.text: To learning a poem at heart

solution:
The correct answer is **no improvement required**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Learn by heart: **To learn something very thoroughly; to memorize something.
 
• Here,** 'learning'** is used as a **gerund.**
 
• A gerund is a verb form that ends in **“-ing”** and is used as a** noun**.
 
• The given sentence is correct and does not require any improvement.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.
